description: Vinicius Souza and colleagues at the University of New Mexico publish household electricity-consumption measurements from the Los Alamos Public Utility Department. Landis+Gyr smart meters recorded 1,757 households in North Mesa, Los Alamos, at fifteen-minute intervals, giving 96 observations per day. Most customers have observations from 30 July 2013 to 30 December 2019, while some have shorter records. Zenodo provides LADPU.zip free under CC0. The landing page does not specify the archive's internal table format, and the files were not downloaded. The authors explicitly identify missing values and duplicated measurements, which require treatment before using the series as model inputs. The measurements can support residential-demand calibration, load diversity studies and distribution-capacity scenarios. They describe one urban service area, not a national household sample. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified by the deposit.
